items.name: Demand for Modern Contraception in Sub-Saharan Africa: New Methods, New Evidence
items.description: Project Overview West and Central Africa have the highest fertility rates in the world. These high birthrates are largely a function of desired fertility and continued allegiance to large families.

items.name: Capacity Building Assistance and Quality Improvement for HIV Care in New Orleans, LA
items.description: Project Overview Facilities, employees, and patients in health care systems related to human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) care face difficulties when extreme weather events, such as hurricanes in New Orleans, Louisiana (NOLA), become more severe and frequent.
